content:
Arjun Patel: Hey Redwood! I'm Arjun — joining as an SWE on infra. Based in Toronto. Big into bonsai, late-night synth jams, and I have an actual pet ferret named Pickle. Excited to meet folks. Also curious: what's the team's go-to after-work spot? :wave:
Marta Liu: Welcome Arjun! Love the name Pickle. We usually rotate between The Alley (boardgame nights) and a rooftop spot. Fridays are chill — sometimes vinyl + snacks. :tada:
Devon Cruz: Welcome! If you like plants, we have a tiny 'green shelf' in the SF office. Also, we have a Slack #vinyl channel where people share records. Bring your favourite record sometime. :)
onboard-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation starts tomorrow at 10:00 PST. Welcome packet sent to your email.
Samir Gupta: ferret!! Please post pics. Also, would you be down for a lunchtime synth demo? I'm terrible but curious. :grin:
Arjun Patel: Yes to both — will bring Pickle's best pose pic and a short loop from my modular rig. Also, any recs for good sandwiches near the office?
Marta Liu: Try "Lola's Deli" two blocks from the lobby. They do an outrageous roasted pepper sammie. Also there's a pickle vendor on Wednesdays. :yum:
Nita Ramos: Welcome! Quick heads up: badge + laptop pickup at 9:30 tomorrow if you want to beat the line. See you!
Arjun Patel: Thanks everyone — pumped to start. See you tomorrow! :raised_hands:
